# OpenCV.js vendor asset

`opencv-4.13.0.js` is the official OpenCV.js 4.13.0 browser build from https://docs.opencv.org/4.13.0/opencv.js. It supplies Lucas?Kanade optical-flow bindings missing from the npm package build. OpenCV is licensed Apache-2.0; see https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.13.0/LICENSE.
